recommended_path: State nonprofit corporation + federal 501(c)(3) exemption determination
entity_types: State nonprofit corporation (incorporated under state law, e.g., Delaware, California)
501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization (federal status layered on the state corporation)
Private charitable trust (less common for GFNP)

requirements.founders: No residency or citizenship requirement for incorporators, directors, or officers; fully remote/foreign founding permitted
requirements.local_presence: Registered agent with a physical street address in the state of incorporation (agent services purchasable); no charity regulator, only tax-exempt status
requirements.documents: Articles of incorporation with tax-exemption and asset-distribution (dissolution) clauses; bylaws

forms: IRS Form 1023-EZ (only if projected annual gross receipts < $50,000) or Form 1023 (full)

fees.note: Prior dataset figure ~$90 is a generic mid-range value; check the specific state
Verified verbatim on irs.gov: 'The user fee for Form 1023-EZ is $275.' Only for projected receipts < $50k.
Verified verbatim on irs.gov: 'The user fee for Form 1023 is $600.' Paid via Pay.gov.
Optional; keeps the setup fully remote

timelines.incorporation: days to 2 weeks (faster in e-filing states like Delaware/California)
timelines.501c3_determination: 6-12 months (IRS processing is the long pole)

supersedes: Prior v2 'US$400-600 IRS Form 1023 fee' corrected to $275 (1023-EZ) / $600 (1023), verified against irs.gov primary source
